description: List the direct dependencies of a specific package version (defaults to latest), via deps.dev. Lets an agent understand what a package pulls in before adding it. Ecosystems: npm, pypi, cargo.

ecosystem.description: Package registry to look in. One of: npm, pypi, cargo.

name.description: Exact package name as published in that registry, e.g. express for npm, requests for pypi, serde for cargo.

version.description: Optional; defaults to the latest/default version

name: package_dependencies
title: Package Dependencies
